build_pattern_rule_ast_rewrite: build a PatternRule that matches AST nodes and rewrites them using a projection function
build_pattern_rules_multiple: build multiple pattern-action pairs with pattern_rules to simplify AST expressions like removing plus zero
test_rule_combinators: test rule combinators like once, many, SomeOf, and AllOf to control how rules apply to AST trees
test_ast_domain_traversal: test top_down and bottom_up traversal combinators from ast_domain to recursively rewrite AST nodes
test_list_edit_rules: test ListEdit and remove_from_list to splice or remove elements from AST node lists
